titre: Mitigating Multimodal LLMs Hallucinations via Relevance Propagation at Inference Time
resume: arXiv:2605.01766v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on vision- and audio-language tasks, yet can generate responses that conflict with the given visual or auditory inputs, a problem known as multimodal hallucinations. Prior work suggests that this occurs when models rely more on textual cues and learned language patterns than on evidence from the perceptual input.
